result.title: Look Beyond the Question: Preserve-Focus-Fuse for Whole-Slide Image Question Answering
result.summary: A question about a whole-slide image rarely names every morphological finding needed to answer it. Question-guided patch selection can therefore overlook supporting morphology, while slide-level compression can dilute focal evidence. Inspired by how pathologists combine broad slide review, question-directed examination, and integration of their findings, we introduce BEYONDPATH, a Preserve-Focus-Fuse framework for whole-slide image question answering. Preserve learns a question-agnostic Morphology Bank through answer supervision across multiple questions about each training slide. Focus retrieves questionspecific evidence from all foreground patches, including regions outside the Bank. Fuse integrates the preserved morphology at the retrieved evidence positions through Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion, producing a fixed 96-token visual prefix. On WSI-Bench, BEYONDPATH achieves an Avg-9 of 0.769 and leads all eight reported report-generation metrics using the same checkpoint. It also achieves 0.639 zero-shot overall accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB. Controlled ablations show complementary benefits from morphology preservation and question-directed retrieval, and support cross-question supervision and fusion at the evidence positions. These results support looking beyond the question's explicit cues: preserving broader slide morphology while retaining the ability to seek evidence for each question.

AI.brief_summary: 面向全切片图像问答提出 BEYONDPATH 的「保留-聚焦-融合」框架：先用答案监督在每张训练切片的多问题上学出与问题无关的形态库，再从全部前景 patch 检索问题相关证据，并在证据位置融合形态信息，输出固定 96 token 的视觉前缀，在 WSI-Bench 与 SlideBench-BCNB 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文直接处理「问题引导筛选会漏掉支撑性形态」「切片级压缩稀释焦点证据」，与视觉证据筛选和压缩致信息坍缩的关切贴近；其与问题无关的形态库、证据位置融合及固定 token 前缀可供核查证据保留与视觉旁路之间的取舍，但属病理专用流程，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与更新。
